title: More control over media uploads
summary:
MiniMax M2.5, clearer model limits, more flexible media uploads, and a storybook app joined a day of API repairs.

Media uploads now accept arbitrary binary files, and an authenticated uploader can delete their own file by hash. The upload limit is now 10 MB.

The `minimax` text model switched from M2.1 to M2.5, with `minimax-m2.5` and `minimax-m2p5` aliases. Model listings now expose `context_length` for 21 text models; clients using the old `context_window` field need to update. Authenticated users without a paid balance no longer see paid-only models in model listings.

PollenPages joined the writing app catalog with a way to turn a genre and story concept into illustrated tales. CatGPT’s meme generator also received image-fetching and interface updates.

daily.title: MiniMax M2.5 replaces M2.1
daily.text: Use `minimax` for MiniMax M2.5 text generation, or select it with the `minimax-m2.5` alias. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax).

daily.title: Upload files, then delete them
daily.text: The media API now accepts arbitrary binary files up to 10 MB. Uploaders can delete their own files by hash with authenticated `DELETE /:hash` requests. [Explore the media API](https://media.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Text model context lengths
daily.text: Model listings now include `context_length` for 21 text models, so you can check token limits before choosing one. If your client reads `context_window`, update it to the new field. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Error recovery, with meditation
daily.text: A new OpenClaw skill generates and plays a short Pollinations TTS meditation after errors. Software still breaks; now it can suggest a breathing exercise.

daily.title: Illustrated stories with PollenPages
daily.text: PollenPages joined the writing app showcase. Give it a genre and story concept to make an illustrated children’s book or fantasy tale. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
